---
title: "system-ui in table styling"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '#set text\(font: \("[^"]+"'
        -
          - '#set text\(font: \([^)]*"(system-ui|sans-serif)"'
---

Regression test for [#11683](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/11683):
a `system-ui` font stack, as emitted by `gt` tables, must resolve to concrete
families rather than reaching Typst as keywords.

::: {style='font-family: system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji"'}

| Col | Num |
|-----|-----|
| abc | 123 |

:::
